from delta.tables import DeltaTable
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, date_format

# 1. Garantir que a database gold existe e definir o caminho de gravação
spark.sql("create database if not exists gold")
path_gold = "abfs://telemetria@stlogitrackdevbrazsouth.dfs.core.windows.net/vehicle/4. GOLD"

# 2. Leitura da Silver de vehicle e Lookup da Dimensão vehicle
df_silver_vh  = spark.table("silver.tb_vh")
dim_vh_lookup = spark.table("gold.dim_vh").select("sk_vh","vehicle_id")

# 3. Construção da Tabela Fato
df_fct_vh_novo = (
    df_silver_vh
     # Join com a dimensão vehicle para trazer a Surrogate Key (sk_wh)
    .join( dim_vh_lookup, on="vehicle_id", how="inner")
    .withColumn("sk_data", date_format(col("timestamp"), "yyyyMMdd").cast("int"))
    # Seleção final mantendo apenas as chaves (FKs), métricas e flags 
    .select(
        "sk_vh",
        "sk_data",
        "velocidade",
        "nivel_combustivel_pct",
        "latitude",
        "longitude",
        "timestamp",
        "status_velocidade",
        "status_combustivel"

    )
)

if not spark.catalog.tableExists("gold.fct_vh"):
    
    (df_fct_vh_novo.write
    .format("delta")
    .option("path",f"{path_gold}/fct_vh")
    .saveAsTable("gold.fct_vh")
    )
else:
    
    delta_fct_vh = DeltaTable.forName(spark ,"gold.fct_vh")

    (
    delta_fct_vh.alias("fato")
    .merge(
        df_fct_vh_novo.alias("novos"),
       " fato.sk_vh = novos.sk_vh AND fato.timestamp = novos.timestamp"
       )
    .whenNotMatchedInsertAll()
    .execute()
